Become a Nostr power user and help shape the future! Open protocols like Nostr give us the opportunity to regain control over our online lives.

At LibreNostr, we don’t rely on advertising. We don’t monetize user data. Our users are our customers. Our sole focus is to make the best possible product for our users. We open source all our work to help the Nostr ecosystem flourish. By signing up for LibreNostr Premium, you are enabling us to continue building for Nostr.

Be the change you want to see in the world. If you don’t want to be the product, consider being the customer.
LibreNostr Pro is the highest user tier at LibreNostr, designed for content creators and teams. Pro users get access to LibreNostr Studio and gain Legend status on LibreNostr:
How do I get support?
Simply email us at support@nostrich.org and include your LibreNostr Name in the message. Support requests from Premium and Pro users are prioritized and typically handled on the same business day.
Can I change my LibreNostr Name?

Yes! If you wish to change your LibreNostr Name, simply use the “Change your LibreNostr Name” option in the Manage Premium section of any LibreNostr app. Your new name will be functional immediately and your old name will be released and available to other users to register.
Do I have to use my LibreNostr verified name and lightning address?

No. As a LibreNostr Premium or Pro user you are able to reserve a LibreNostr Name, but you are not required to use it as your nostr verified address (NIP-05), nor the bitcoin lightning address. Simply set any nostr verified address and/or the bitcoin lightning address you wish to use in your Nostr account profile settings.
I used to be in the LibreNostr Legend tier. Do I get access to LibreNostr Pro now?
Yes! All LibreNostr Legend users as of June 20, 2025 have been upgraded to LibreNostr Pro—no expiration, no extra cost. It’s our way of thanking you for being an early supporter.
Do I own my LibreNostr Name indefinitely?

You have the right to use your LibreNostr Name for the duration of your LibreNostr subscription. After the subscription expires, there is a grace period of 30 days during which your LibreNostr Name will not be available to others to register. Please note that all LibreNostr Names are owned by LibreNostr and rented to users. LibreNostr reserves the right to revoke any name if we determine that the name is trademarked by somebody else, that there is a possible case of impersonation, or for any other case of abuse, as determined by LibreNostr. Please refer to our Terms of Service for details.
Can I buy multiple LibreNostr Names?
We are working on adding the capability to manage multiple LibreNostr Names. In the meantime, feel free to reach out to us via support@nostrich.org and we will try to accommodate.
Is my payment information associated with my Nostr account?

No. LibreNostr Premium can be purchased via an iOS App Store in-app purchase, Google Play in-app purchase, or directly over bitcoin lightning via the LibreNostr web app. Regardless of the method of payment, your payment information is not associated with your Nostr account.
Can I extend my subscription? How does that work?

Yes, you can extend your subscription using any of the payment methods we support: iOS App Store in-app purchase, Google Play in-app purchase, or directly over bitcoin lightning via the LibreNostr web app. Any payment will extend your subscription by the number of months purchased. For example, if you purchase 3 Months of LibreNostr Premium using the LibreNostr web app, and then subscribe again via your mobile device, your subscription expiry date will be four months in the future, and it will continue to be pushed out with every subsequent monthly payment.
If I buy LibreNostr Premium on my phone, will I have access to it on the web?

Yes. Your LibreNostr Premium subscription is assigned to your Nostr account. Therefore, regardless of the way you choose to subscribe, your LibreNostr Premium subscription will be available to you in all LibreNostr apps: web, iOS, Android.
How does the Nostr contact list backup feature work?

LibreNostr creates a backup of 100+ most recent versions of your Nostr follow list. If your follow list gets erased or corrupted by another Nostr app, you will be able to restore it using the Contact List Backup tool in the Nostr Tools section for LibreNostr Premium users.
How does the Nostr account content backup feature work?

LibreNostr archives the complete history of all your Nostr content. You can rebroadcast any subset of your content to your selected set of relays at any time using the Content Backup tool in the Nostr Tools section for LibreNostr Premium users.
What other Premium features are coming in the future?

We are working on a ton of new and exciting features for LibreNostr Premium. We will announce them as we get closer to releasing them. In the meantime, please feel free to reach out and let us know what you would like to see included in LibreNostr Premium. All suggestions are welcome!
I’d like to support LibreNostr. Can I do more?

At LibreNostr, we don’t rely on advertising. We don’t monetize user data. We open source all our work to help the Nostr ecosystem flourish. If you wish to help us continue doing this work, you can purchase a Premium or Pro subscription, or simply leave a 5-star review in the app store. Thank you from the entire LibreNostr Team! 🙏❤️
